meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 装上后,它会为选定的代理组添加两个工具:网络搜索和网页提取,都不需要 API key。免费额度用完时,它会引导你创建自己的 key 并保存,key 不会经过它。
howto.when: 当你想给某个代理组安装 Tavily 网络搜索或网址提取、且没有 API key 时触发。

say.text: 给 coding 组安装 Tavily 搜索,不要 API key。
say.note: 会为该组注册 tavily MCP 服务器。

say.text: 帮 research 组加上 Tavily 提取工具。
Tavily 额度用完了,帮我升级。
say.note: 引导你创建并保存自己的 key。

howto.what_en: After installation, it adds two tools—web search and URL extraction—for selected agent groups, no API key needed. When the free allowance runs out, it guides you to create and save your own key; the key never passes through it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to install Tavily web search or URL extraction for an agent group without an API key.

say_en.text: Install Tavily Search for the coding group, no API key.
say_en.note: Registers the tavily MCP server for that group.

say_en.text: Add the Tavily Extract tool to the research group.
Tavily free allowance is used up; help me upgrade.
say_en.note: Guides you through creating and saving your key.
